tasks.title: Checkpoint replacement ignores durability failures
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: writeCheckpoint ignores fallback fsync result at 359; ignores directory open failure and directory fsync result at 367–371, then returns success. A failed data barrier does not prevent rename of the replacement.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Inject file and directory sync errors; preserve old journal before successful data sync; report uncertain durability after rename. Verify replay and crash recovery.

tasks.title: Prevent actor reentrancy from clearing unsynced append accounting
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: performBarrier awaits a blocking queue then sets pendingSinceSync to zero if descriptor unchanged. Actor can accept append while suspended; those records may be written after barrier syscall but before completion. Comment claiming appends queue behind the await is not a Swift actor guarantee.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Deterministic barrier/append interleaving test; count only records captured by completed durability barrier, preserve newer pending writes.

tasks.title: Establish serialization of append versus compaction
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: compact awaits a checkpoint replacement on a blocking queue; append writes to existing descriptor. Unless every caller provides external serialization, an append during suspension may land on the old inode and disappear after reopen. Caller contract not yet established.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Trace all FileJournal callers; reproduce with controlled suspension; guarantee append preservation or explicitly enforce isolation.
tasks.classification: investigation candidate; not a confirmed defect

tasks.title: Propagate asynchronous journal durability failures
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: Scheduled performBarrier uses try?; shutDown also discards errors from settleBarrier and performBarrier before closing and releasing lock, despite async throws signature.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Fault inject fsync errors; expose degraded status and shutdown error while guaranteeing resource cleanup; verify retry and pending count.

tasks.title: Distinguish corrupt complete journal records from torn tail
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: decodeRecords silently drops every complete line whose JSON decoding fails, not just a final unterminated tail; no diagnostic is returned. Corruption or incompatible records may be lost before compaction.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Test middle-line corruption and incompatible records; report rejected record positions, preserve recoverability and avoid destructive compaction without policy.

tasks.title: Validate journal file type, ownership and permissions
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: O_NOFOLLOW and 0600 apply to final write path/creation, but existing file mode/type is not checked in shown openers; readContents follows final symlinks and reads until EOF. Parent-directory symlinks are intentional. Determine whether untrusted workspaces can supply FIFO, device, hardlink or permissive files.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Trace workspace path trust; test non-regular files and existing insecure modes on scratch store; ensure no blocking or unintended read/write; preserve documented directory symlink support.
tasks.classification: investigation candidate; not a confirmed defect

tasks.title: Handle short pread during tail repair without truncating unread bytes
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: Tail repair accepts any nonnegative read length, searches only the returned prefix, then sets end to offset, skipping an unread suffix if a short read occurs. Subsequent ftruncate may discard a complete record.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Inject short reads and EINTR; require complete range reads or fail without truncating; verify byte-identical valid tail.

tasks.title: Bound HTTP header buffering before decoder completes
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: Source explicitly acknowledges NIO accumulates unbounded small headers before application aggregate-limit checks. Pipeline config has no earlier aggregate bound. Server binds loopback, limiting exposure but not local denial of service.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Add pre-decode aggregate header byte/count gate or prove equivalent decoder protection; test incrementally supplied oversized headers and bounded RSS.

tasks.title: Bound stored response memory by bytes and chain size
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: ResponseStore caps number of entries, not bytes; each continuation flattens prior conversation into storedInput, and entries retain input/output plus response JSON. A count cap does not bound accumulated history byte size. Generation context limits may reduce practical impact; measure.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Test long continuation chains and many near-limit responses; enforce aggregate byte budget and chain bounds; document eviction semantics.

tasks.title: Validate loopback trust boundary, Host and browser-origin protections
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: Server explicitly binds loopback; route checks Host presence only and JSON content type via prefix. Review DNS rebinding and local multi-user process access, including stored responses and model unload. No remote exploit established.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Document single-user trust model; test allowed Host values, browser origin behavior, invalid media types and control endpoints; implement mitigation if threat model requires.
tasks.classification: investigation candidate; not a confirmed defect

tasks.title: Parse media type exactly instead of accepting application/json prefix
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: hasPrefix("application/json") accepts unrelated media types such as application/jsonx. Expected exact media type with optional parameters; bodyless route policy remains separate.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Test valid parameters, casing and invalid suffixes across API surfaces.

tasks.title: Prove allocation products and BLAS narrowing safe at Swift–C boundary
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: Scratch sizes multiply size_t dimensions without overflow checks; BLAS dimensions explicitly narrow to int. C entry point checks only nonzero dimensions. Need caller reachability and shape bounds before classifying runtime impact.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Trace all Swift callers and manifest-derived dimensions; test overflow/INT_MAX boundary in isolated sanitizer harness; reject unsafe geometry before allocating or narrowing.
tasks.classification: investigation candidate; not a confirmed defect

tasks.title: Prove C reader offset bounds and destruction versus active batch lifecycle
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: Offset cast to off_t and addition lack local checked arithmetic; destroy signals work_ready, joins workers and frees state while submit waits on work_done and outstanding. Need verify caller ownership prohibits concurrent destroy and validates ranges.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Trace Swift wrapper and header ownership; test boundary offsets, cancellation and destruction during active batch under ASan/UBSan/TSan if contract permits; enforce lifecycle.
tasks.classification: investigation candidate; not a confirmed defect

tasks.title: Serialize catalog and configuration fields as safe YAML scalars
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: textField rejects newline/tab but permits YAML syntax; builder interpolates ids, names, provider keys, effort values and reasoning as unquoted YAML. Config provider/reasoning only checked for nonempty. Inputs containing YAML special characters can change structure or fail parse.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Round-trip adversarial scalar cases and malformed config with YAML parser; enforce intended scalar values; update linked shell writer parity tests as necessary.

tasks.title: Make settings rewrite atomic and detect concurrent updates
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: Read settings then optional copy backup followed by writeFileSync directly to target. Interrupted write can truncate user profile; concurrent editor changes after read can be overwritten. Backup does not make replacement atomic.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Fault inject interruption and concurrent edit; use safe replacement preserving file mode and detect conflicts; verify both route/default-model branches.

tasks.title: Report malformed catalog rows rather than silently dropping them
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: catalogRows broad catch continues with no diagnostic; comment says corresponding shell parser prints a skip message. Malformed install disappears silently from picker.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Retain useful valid rows, report safe row-specific rejection reason; test malformed entries without exposing credentials.

tasks.title: Require safe integer compaction headroom
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: resolveCompactionHeadroom uses Number.isInteger, accepts integer-valued unsafe IEEE-754 numbers unlike resolveRouteTokenCount at 173–179.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Boundary tests for MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, unsafe integer, nonnumeric and boolean inputs; document valid range and type.

tasks.title: Verify bounded GGUF metadata parser resource use and duplicate handling
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: Key/tensor counts are capped at <2^20; metadata duplicates overwrite earlier entries; arrays iterate each element even if not retained. Need caller header-size limits and duplicate/tensor contract before asserting vulnerability.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Trace local and remote callers; test duplicate keys/tensors, large arrays, invalid empty array element types, malformed offsets, memory/time bounds.
tasks.classification: investigation candidate; not a confirmed defect

tasks.title: Verify overflow-safe compressed expert block-count arithmetic
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: Ceiling formula phaseBytes + blockBytes - 1 uses unchecked addition. Need prove bounds/types at all decode and encode call sites.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Trace phase size validation; test maximum phase lengths; use checked arithmetic or division/remainder where needed.
tasks.classification: investigation candidate; not a confirmed defect

tasks.title: Guard against zero-progress write loops
tasks.discovered-by: Discovery-only static source inspection at pinned revision
tasks.evidence-before: Both writeFully loops advance offset only by write return value; zero return with remaining bytes neither throws nor advances, causing nontermination if such a write occurs.
tasks.acceptance-criteria: Inject zero-write result on scratch descriptor seam; fail with explicit I/O error instead of spinning; preserve EINTR retry.
